messages:
Lina (sales): Heads-up: HorizonHealth wants a 48h POC next week. They'll run a smoke + throughput validation. Need reserved GPU preheat plan, autoscale JSON, cost delta for quant, and security Q responses.
Rob (solutions): Whats their traffic shape? bursts vs steady, typical tokens?
Lina (sales): Baseline ~55 qps, short bursts to ~240 qps for 25m. Avg response ~110 tokens. Little embedding.
Kavita (infra): Quick sizing: reserve 6 GPUs, burst credits for +4 GPUs for up to 3m, autoscale to 12 if sustained. Metrics: queued_requests + p95_latency.
Marta (sre): Agree on burst credits to avoid cold starts. Also add an eviction tolerance table for spot fallback.
Rob (solutions): Quantized (q8) gives ~+2530% throughput usually; note: might need +12 GPUs to match tail latency in some cases. Will include sensitivity table in quote.
Ethan (security): On questionnaire: Dedicated supports VPC peering/private deploy, customer KMS, SOC2 Type II, console IP allowlist, SSO. Send PDF and I'll draft answers.
Kavita (infra): Preheat runbook snippet:
```
- Deploy canary to reserved pool
- Seed top-60 prompts to KV cache
- Run warmer @ 10 qps for 10m
- Verify kv_cache_hit_rate >= 60% and p95 latency target
- If low hit_rate -> expand seed set; if p95 too high -> add GPU
```
Lina (sales): Can someone paste the autoscale JSON we can hand to their ops?
Kavita (infra): {"autoscale": "{\"min_reserved\":6,\"max_reserved\":12,\"scale_step_secs\":30,\"burst_credit_threshold_secs\":180,\"metrics\":[\"queued_requests\",\"p95_latency\"]}"}
SchedBot: Scheduled horizon_poc_smoke for 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z. Report will be posted here. :robot_face:
Rob (solutions): I'll drop a 1-pager sizing rationale, a pricing delta (quant opt), the preheat runbook, and a filled sec checklist draft by EOD today. Lina, ping legal when Ethan is done.
Lina (sales): Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
